convert_bmg_to_mini_json: convert a BMGraphBuilder probabilistic program graph into a Mini BMG JSON string representation
create_to_mini_converter: create a ToMini instance to serialize BMG nodes into a compact Mini BMG format
serialize_distribution_nodes: serialize Bernoulli, Beta, and Normal distribution nodes into Mini BMG distribution operators

map_operator_nodes: map multiplication and sample operator nodes into their corresponding Mini BMG operator representations
